title: 第602章 冥河出关天螟转世第601章 太昊陨落物归原主
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
东海之上，太昊那巍峨的九爪金龙道躯已然彻底湮灭，属于一代龙帝的无上气息，最终化作漫天凄风苦雨，彻底消散于苍茫海天之间。
而就在不久之前，准提道人与烛龙圣人交锋，同样以准提肉身崩裂、遭受重创而告终，引得天地同悲，万道哀鸣。
接连两桩足以撼动整个洪荒格局的惊天巨变，宛如两块巨石被狠狠砸入沉寂了万古的深潭。
层层叠叠的道韵涟漪穿透了天地壁垒，如无形的风暴般，向着洪荒大地的每一处隐秘角落疯狂扩散。
而长久以来在洪荒虚空中那层无形无质、长久笼罩洪荒、蒙蔽推演、遮掩因果的法则屏障，此刻也消失不见。
那是扬眉道人留驻洪荒的本源力量，本用来遮蔽诸天天机，混淆大能卜算。此刻扬眉的力量抽身远去，踏入混沌深处与帝江对峙博弈，留在洪荒的遮蔽之力失去了根基，如同狂风卷过薄雾，一点点消散无踪。
长久浑浊、模糊难测的洪荒天机，终于在这一刻重归清明。
诸天万界，无数蛰伏于秘境、混沌裂隙、洞天福地之内闭关沉睡的上古大能，纷纷自亘古的沉寂之中苏醒。
一道道浩瀚莫测的气息此起彼伏地冲破结界，无数双洞悉万古的眼眸穿透虚空，望向洪荒四海，想要看清这接连爆发的厮杀与变局。
火云洞天。
此地祥云万道，地脉蒸腾着浓郁的先天巫道元气。无数血色河道纹路交织遍布洞天大地，浓郁的灵魂道韵弥漫四方，透着森然与神秘。
长久紧闭的洞天核心石门，伴随着沉闷的轰鸣缓缓向外敞开。一道身影自无尽血色迷雾之中缓步踏出。
那是一名面容俊美到雌雄莫辨的青年男子，肌肤莹白如玉，眉眼柔和，可若仔细看去，便会发现那一双眼底，沉睡着源自混沌魔神的苍茫戾气。
他一身血色长袍随风轻扬，衣摆流淌着万千灵魂光丝，周身萦绕着无尽的亡魂道力。此人，正是巫族三圣之一，冥河。
漫长闭关一朝落幕，磅礴浩荡的圣人威压席卷整座火云洞天。
冥河周身流转的道韵层层攀升，最终稳稳定格在混元大罗金仙五重天。闭关苦修，一朝突破，实力暴涨一大境。
冥河微微抬眸，望向东方虚空。清明的天机毫无保留地铺展在他的感知之中，无数被尘封的因果画面流转浮现。
很快，一道熟悉的身影映入感知，正是他座下首徒，蚊道人天螟。
一幕幕惨烈的厮杀图景缓缓铺开：碧波谭秘境鏖战，天螟奋力搏杀，最终却是不敌太一，落得个身死道消的下场。
“天螟，命也啊。”

冥河轻声一叹，俊美无俦的面容上掠过一抹难以掩饰的怅然。天螟与他同出血海一脉，更是他收下的第一位亲传弟子，承载着他不少期许。
如今天螟骤然陨落，纵使身为巫族圣人，见惯了洪荒生灭，冥河心中依旧生出了深深的惋惜。
他调动圣人级别的灵魂法则，顺着天机脉络不断追溯，将碧波谭秘境发生的一切始末尽数洞悉。
鲲鹏出手设局，太一施以绝杀，两大顶尖强者联手，才令天螟无力回天。
惋惜转瞬褪去，彻骨寒意自冥河神魂深处升腾而起，血色眸光骤然冰冷。
“鲲鹏，太一。”
低沉的嗓音回荡在火云洞天，带着混沌魔神与生俱来的杀伐执念。
“联手设计困杀本座首徒，此仇不共戴天，他日定要尔等血债血偿！”
杀意浓烈，足以冻结一方天地。可冥河并未一时冲动，立刻动身前往东海寻太一，或是远赴北冥追杀鲲鹏。
content_en:
Above the East China Sea, Taihao's majestic nine-clawed golden dragon body has been completely annihilated. The supreme aura belonging to a generation of Dragon Emperors has finally turned into miserable wind and bitter rain, completely dissipating between the vast sea and sky.
Not long ago, the confrontation between Taoist Zhunti and Saint Zhulong also ended with Zhunti's physical body breaking apart and suffering severe injuries, which caused the world to mourn and all the people to cry out.
Two huge changes in succession were enough to shake the entire prehistoric structure, like two huge rocks being smashed into a deep pool that had been silent for eternity.
Layers upon layers of ripples of Dao Yun penetrated the barrier of heaven and earth, spreading crazily towards every hidden corner of the ancient land like an invisible storm.
And the invisible and insubstantial barrier of laws that had long shrouded the prehistoric void, obscured deductions, and concealed cause and effect, also disappeared at this moment.
That is the original power that Yangmei Taoist left in the ancient world. It was originally used to obscure the secrets of the heavens and confuse the divination of the great powers. At this moment, the power of raising eyebrows withdrew and stepped into the depths of chaos to confront Dijiang. The shielding power left in the wilderness lost its foundation, like a strong wind blowing through the mist, dissipating little by little without a trace.
The secret of the ancient world, which had been cloudy, vague and unpredictable for a long time, finally returned to clarity at this moment.
In all the heavens and worlds, countless ancient powers who were sleeping in seclusion in secret realms, Chaos Rifts, and Cave Heaven Paradise have all awakened from the eternal silence.
Vast and unpredictable auras broke through the barrier one after another, and countless pairs of eyes with insight into eternity penetrated the void and looked across the world, trying to see clearly the fighting and changes that broke out one after another.
Fire cloud cave sky.
There are thousands of auspicious clouds here, and the earth's veins are steaming with rich innate witchcraft energy. Countless blood-colored river lines are intertwined all over the cave sky and the earth, and the rich spiritual charm permeates all directions, revealing the splendor and mystery.
The stone door at the core of the cave that had been closed for a long time slowly opened with a dull roar. A figure slowly stepped out of the endless bloody mist.
It was a young man with an indistinguishable androgynous face. His skin was as white as jade, and his eyebrows were soft. But if you look carefully, you will find that beneath those eyes, sleeping is the vast and violent aura originating from the Chaos Demon God.
His blood-colored robe fluttered gently in the wind, and the hem of his clothes was flowing with thousands of soul light threads, and he was surrounded by endless soul power. This person is none other than Styx, one of the Three Saints of the Witch Clan.
As soon as the long retreat came to an end, the majestic pressure of the saint swept across the entire Fire Cloud Cave.
The Taoist rhyme circulating around the Styx climbed up layer by layer, and finally stabilized at the fifth level of Hunyuan Daluo Golden Immortal. After practicing hard in seclusion, once he breaks through, his strength will skyrocket.
Styx raised his eyes slightly and looked into the eastern void. The clear secrets of heaven unfolded unreservedly in his perception, and countless dust-covered scenes of cause and effect emerged.
Soon, a familiar figure came into view, it was his first disciple, Mosquito Taoist Ren Tianxiao.
Scenes of brutal fighting slowly unfolded: a fierce battle in the Bibotan secret realm, Tianbo fought hard, but in the end he lost to Taiyi and ended up dead.
"Heavenly Borer is destined to die."
Styx sighed softly, and a trace of unconcealable sadness flashed across his handsome face. Tian Ye is from the same bloodline as him, and is the first direct disciple he accepted, carrying many of his expectations.
Now that Tian Bo died suddenly, even though he was a saint of the Wu Clan and was used to seeing life and death in ancient times, Ming He still felt deep regret in his heart.
He mobilized the soul laws of the saint level, continuously traced the secrets of heaven, and understood everything that happened in the Bibotan secret realm.
Kunpeng set up a trap, Taiyi executed a decisive blow, and the two top powerhouses joined forces to make Tianbo unable to recover.
The regret faded away in an instant, a bone-chilling chill rose from the depths of Styx's soul, and the blood-colored eyes suddenly turned cold.
"Kunpeng, Taiyi."
The deep voice echoed in the Fire Cloud Cave, carrying the innate killing obsession of the Chaos Demon God.
"Joined forces to trap and kill my chief disciple. This hatred is irreconcilable. We will definitely demand your blood in the future."Pay! "
The killing intent is strong enough to freeze the world. But Minghe was not impulsive and immediately set off to the East China Sea to find Taiyi, or to go to the North Ming Dynasty to hunt down Kunpeng.
